Returns indexes for peptides with significant difference between two sets

Source: R/robot_indexes_df.R
robot_indexes.Rd

Function to help decide which peptides will be drawn on Robot plots.

Usage

robot_indexes(
  thP,
  th,
  replicates = 3,
  pvalue = 0.01,
  states,
  alpha = 0.01,
  p_adjust = "none",
  min_timepoints = 1
)

Arguments

thP

output of output_tc(percent = TRUE). Raw data for procent deuteration for time courses

th

output of output_tc(). Raw data for uptake deuteration for time courses

replicates

number of replicates in sample. Default set to 3.

pvalue

p-value cutoff. Default set up to 0.01

states

Protein states from the set. As default all states are chosen.

alpha

critical interval, to have more restrictive use lower values, default=0.01

p_adjust

multiple-testing correction of the Welch p-values, passed to stats::p.adjust(): "none" (default, raw p-values) or e.g. "BH". A peptide is significant when its (adjusted) p-value is below the cutoff AND its difference exceeds the critical interval.

min_timepoints

a peptide is selected when it is significant at at least this many time points. Default 1 (any time point, as before).

Value

Returns indexes of significant peptides: row numbers in the states[1] vs states[2] table used by the robot plots. A significant peptide that is not in that table (e.g. its sequence differs in a mutant) is left out; robot_indexes_df() lists every significant peptide.

Examples

file_nm<-system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
tm_df<-output_tc(filepath=file_nm)
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 1 peptide row(s) dropped: 1 not measured in every time point, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: 3.00s=3 60.00s=3 1800.00s=3 72000.00s=3
#> no csv file written
tmP_df<-output_tc(filepath=file_nm, percent=TRUE)
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 1 peptide row(s) dropped: 1 not measured in every time point, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: 3.00s=3 60.00s=3 1800.00s=3 72000.00s=3
#> no csv file written

 # more restictive peptide selection
robot_indexes(thP = tmP_df, th=tm_df, pvalue=0.001, alpha=0.01)
#>  [1]  1  2  3  4  7  8  9 10 11 12 13 15 16 17 18 19 21 22 23 24 26 28
